deduplication.exact: SHA256 of NFKC, lowercase, whitespace-collapsed text
deduplication.near: Bottom-32 sketch of word 5-gram hashes; candidates share one of 4 smallest hashes; estimated Jaccard >= 0.8
deduplication.large_bucket_policy: discard new document as repetitive; log separately
deduplication.limitations: Approximate near-duplicate filtering, not a proof of zero residual overlap

split: BLAKE2b(hostname without www., person=ad-split-v1) mod 1000: 0..4 validation, 5..9 test, remainder train; same normalized hostname stays in one split
ordering: Fixed parquet order and original row order; sample/10BT is the dataset's pre-randomized sample
storage: uint16 little-endian GPT-2 IDs; EOS after each document; document offsets and hashes in JSONL
packing: Training uses contiguous fixed-length sequences from EOS-separated stream, with attention across document boundaries inside a sequence; all methods share exactly the same stream. Evaluation can use recorded document boundaries.
